purpose: A controlled set of family composition archetypes. Every family stays in the JURNL world (bone paper, emerald / wine / champagne accents, display serif + tracked sans, square-rounded controls, the family plate) while its composition encodes its job.
shared_world_constants: SQUARE-ROUNDED CONTROLS, NO CIRCULAR TAPPABLE BUTTONS
DISPLAY SERIF + TRACKED SANS, ALL UPPERCASE
FAMILY PLATE AS ENVIRONMENT, NEVER AS THE ONLY DIFFERENTIATOR
LANGUAGE LAYERS: FUNCTION LABEL → STATE → TASK → EDITORIAL (OPTIONAL)
rule_adjacency: No more than 2 adjacent families (F03→F16 order) may share an archetype. Measured: 0 adjacent repeats.

archetypes.name: CABINET / WARDROBE
archetypes.mental_model: A cabinet of labelled shelves; each place is a drawer you pull open.
archetypes.spatial_grammar: Brass-rule plaque at the top; full-width shelves stacked below, each with a vertical edge label (EVERYDAY / SAVED / OWED / OTHER) and drawers with a centred pull; a base with ADD A PLACE (dashed slot) + SEE ALL PLACES.
archetypes.rhythm: Even, stacked, ruled; repeated drawer modules inside ruled shelves.
archetypes.interaction_emphasis: Open a drawer (a place); add a place in the empty slot.
archetypes.typographic_role: Wide-tracked display plaque title; numerals in display face; labels in small tracked sans.
archetypes.panel_treatment: Shelf panels with inset drawers; drawer pulls as small horizontal bars.

archetypes.name: THRESHOLD / PROTECTED ZONE
archetypes.mental_model: A doorway: above the line is clear to spend, below it is held back.
archetypes.spatial_grammar: Arched paper panel, centred; one large figure above a full-width threshold line with tick marks; hatched bands below the line show each held amount proportionally; two equal actions under it.
information_hierarchy: STATE: HOW COMPLETE THE READING IS
CLEAR TO SPEND / OVER BY FIGURE
HELD BANDS (BILLS, PLAN, GOALS, RESERVES, BUFFER)
archetypes.rhythm: Symmetric, centred, one heavy figure then light bands.
archetypes.interaction_emphasis: Read the figure; SEE THE FULL BREAKDOWN; CHANGE WHAT’S HELD.
archetypes.typographic_role: Small tracked sans function label as H1; the figure is the display hero.
archetypes.panel_treatment: Arched top panel; hatched (diagonal) bands with share bars.

archetypes.name: OBJECT ON A PLINTH
archetypes.mental_model: One thing under consideration sits on a plinth; its consequences orbit it.
archetypes.spatial_grammar: Short intro card; arched niche/plinth centred with the object name + price; the decide control attached to the plinth base; a 3-cell orbit (FITS? / SAFE TO SPEND AFTER / STATUS) beneath; others shelved below.
information_hierarchy: STATE: HOW MANY PURCHASES ARE UNDER CONSIDERATION
VERDICT (FITS NOW / CLOSE / NOT YET) + SAFE TO SPEND AFTER
archetypes.rhythm: Centred single focal object, then a horizontal orbit, then a quiet shelf.
archetypes.interaction_emphasis: Decide on the one object; consider something else.
archetypes.typographic_role: Small sans function label; display serif for the object name.
archetypes.panel_treatment: Arched niche with plinth; attached full-width decide control.
archetypes.do_not_use_for: More than one primary object at a time.

archetypes.name: ROUTE / DESTINATION
archetypes.mental_model: A route from here to a destination, marked by stops; funding fills the line.
archetypes.spatial_grammar: Intro card; a vertical route line with diamond stop marks: FROM HERE (today’s safe to spend) → FUNDING (reserved of budget, FUND THIS TRIP) → DESTINATION (large display name); other trips as rows with their own funding lines.
archetypes.rhythm: Vertical progression with stops; the destination is the visual end of the line.
archetypes.interaction_emphasis: Fund this trip; open the destination; plan another trip.
archetypes.typographic_role: Display serif destination; tracked sans kickers on each stop.
archetypes.panel_treatment: Route line gradient filled by --funded; diamond marks.

archetypes.name: STAIR / SEQUENCE
archetypes.mental_model: A staircase down: each balance is a step in the paydown order.
archetypes.spatial_grammar: Landing slab (heavy 4px top border) with plan state and CHANGE THE PLAN; steps indented progressively (--step × 20px) with large index numerals 01 02 03; partial note; TRY AN EXTRA PAYMENT.
information_hierarchy: STATE: YOUR PLAN (STRATEGY — RULE) OR NOT SET
EXTRA PER MONTH ACROSS N BALANCES
STEP ORDER WITH BALANCE, APR, NEXT PAYMENT
archetypes.interaction_emphasis: Change the plan; try an extra payment; open a step.
archetypes.typographic_role: Display index numerals; display H1 on the landing.
archetypes.panel_treatment: Treads with a top rule; landing slab.

archetypes.name: HORIZON / SCENARIO
archetypes.mental_model: Looking out to a horizon: today, the next 30 days, and the open distance; dated windows below.
archetypes.spatial_grammar: Wide-tracked display H1; a 3-cell horizon band on a line with an arrow (TODAY / NEXT 30 DAYS / LATER); risk line; time windows (THIS WEEK / NEXT WEEK / LATER THIS MONTH / AFTER 30 DAYS / NO DATE YET) each a panel with a marker spine; a fork panel with TRY ANOTHER PATH.
information_hierarchy: STATE: WHAT THE NEXT 30 DAYS LOOK LIKE (OR TOO LITTLE KNOWN)
archetypes.rhythm: Horizontal band first, then vertical windows; certainty shown per row.
archetypes.typographic_role: Wide-tracked display H1; display figures on the band; tracked sans window labels.
archetypes.panel_treatment: Band line with markers; windows with a dotted spine.

archetypes.name: SCENARIO FORK (SECONDARY)
archetypes.mental_model: A fork in the path: the base and an alternative.
archetypes.spatial_grammar: Used as the secondary archetype inside HORIZON_PATH (the fork panel with TRY ANOTHER PATH); the F15 branch child screens keep their existing layout.
archetypes.do_not_use_for: A family root on its own.

archetypes.name: ARCHIVE / INDEX
archetypes.mental_model: A filing cabinet: a label holder on the drawer, folders with staggered tabs, index cards inside.
archetypes.spatial_grammar: Label holder with brass end caps (RECORDS + FILED / OPEN counts); a find field with an attached tab-shaped ADD A RECORD; folders by type, each with a tab staggered by index (--tab × 30%) and stacked index cards.
information_hierarchy: STATE: N RECORDS FILED, NONE OPEN
archetypes.rhythm: Indexed, tabbed, staggered; cards stacked tight.
archetypes.interaction_emphasis: Find; add a record; open a card.
archetypes.typographic_role: Sans wide-tracked H1 inside the label holder (archival); small caps metadata.
archetypes.panel_treatment: Folders with tabs; index cards with a ruled edge.

archetypes.name: LEDGER
archetypes.mental_model: A ruled ledger page with columns.
archetypes.spatial_grammar: Ruled background, double left border, a header row with column names; rows in columns; actions under the ledger.
archetypes.interaction_emphasis: Open a row; add a row.
archetypes.do_not_use_for: Adjacent families (F06 and F12 are not adjacent; F12 adds a utilization meter variant).

archetypes.name: TIMELINE
archetypes.mental_model: A dated column: what arrives, in order.
archetypes.spatial_grammar: Date column on the left, items on a spine; overdue in wine; grouped THIS WEEK / LATER.
archetypes.interaction_emphasis: Open an item; add what repeats.
archetypes.typographic_role: Wide-tracked sans H1; dates in small tracked sans.

archetypes.name: ROOM / ZONE PLAN
archetypes.mental_model: A floor plan: each intention is a room whose width is its share.
archetypes.spatial_grammar: Proportional plan band (zone widths = share of assigned); 2-column rooms; PLAN AROUND links to SAFE TO SPEND / GOALS / PURCHASES / TRIPS / AHEAD.
archetypes.interaction_emphasis: Open a zone; add an intention.
archetypes.typographic_role: Display H1; zone labels in tracked sans.

archetypes.name: EDITORIAL SPREAD
archetypes.mental_model: A magazine spread: each goal is a page with a progress rule.
archetypes.spatial_grammar: Italic display H1; goal spreads with a progress line (--share); actions under.
archetypes.interaction_emphasis: Name a goal; open a goal.
archetypes.typographic_role: Italic display H1 (only family that uses it).

archetypes.name: FOCUS / REVEAL
archetypes.mental_model: One signal first, then what is close, coming and moved.
archetypes.spatial_grammar: Left-anchored display stack (F03 parent composition kept): signal, attention, coming, moved, more; on the frame it paginates instead of running under the nav.
archetypes.rhythm: Signal first, then a quiet rail.
archetypes.interaction_emphasis: See why; open what is coming.
archetypes.typographic_role: Display H1 and figure (F03 authority kept).
archetypes.panel_treatment: Existing F03 parent panels, now atomic frame panels.

archetypes.name: DETAIL / CHILD SCREEN
archetypes.mental_model: One record, one form: the child screen of a family.
archetypes.spatial_grammar: Paper intro, single column (max 360px), panels stacked on the frame.
used_by: ALL FAMILY CHILD SCREENS VIA JurnlFamilyShell
